rationale: PINS the G2 gap: pattern types are real type usages — case p: Point (typed_pattern) and case Point(a, b) (case_class_pattern) reference Point. Previously only the case-class parameter types emitted declared_type refs; the pattern type was invisible. infix_pattern (case a :: b) carries NO type_identifier and stays silent — it is a binding pattern, not a type-carrying one.
